Titles.eng: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
Titles.jpn: 当て馬キャラのくせして、スパダリ王子に寵愛されています。

Summaries.eng:
Side Character — Unimportant. Constantly getting in the way of the main characters' love story.

After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?!

"A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience."

Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!
Summaries.jpn:
ずっと…君に触れたかった――
【スパダリ溺愛王子×ライバル当て馬】
ヒロインを取り合うはずが…なんで王子が俺を狙ってるの!?

当て馬とは――物語の主役の恋路を阻む「お邪魔キャラ」。
邪魔をして断罪をされないよう、ヒーローの王子アレクを必死に避けていたのに…
なんと王子は当て馬ロニールに夢中!?

Aliases: Ateuma kyara no kuse shite, supadari ōji ni chōai sa rete imasu
Even though he is a guessing horse character, he is loved by Prince Spadari.

Titles.eng: You're the One...I've Always Longed For
Titles.jpn: 第1話：ずっと君に触れたかった

Summaries.eng: Following an accident, Loneal finds himself reborn as a side character in the renowned fantasy novel, 'The Silver Prince and the Holy Bride.' As a fan of the novel in his former life, Loneal is aware of the plot, and does his utmost to avoid meddling in the developing romance between the story's primary hero, Prince Alec, and the captivating heroine, Lily. However, despite Loneal's earnest attempts, he ends up in a precarious situation. Just when he braces himself for Prince Alec's condemnation, the story's hero instead confesses to Loneal, saying, "I've always wanted to touch you..." His eyes ablaze with passion!
Summaries.jpn: 小説の当て馬キャラ・ロニールに転生した「俺」。ヒロインとの恋路を邪魔して罪に問われないよう、ヒーローの王子・アレクを遠くから見るにとどめていた。当て馬は当て馬らしくいなければ…！と、立ち位置を把握していたのに、うっかりヒロインとの仲を疑われてしまい…!!断罪決定…と思ったら――「ずっと…君に触れたかった」。熱っぽい瞳で求められてしまい…!?

Titles.eng: Let's Recreate the Magic From Yesterday

Summaries.eng: As Loneal struggles to create an antidote for the love potion, Alec approaches him with a proposition for a date, both donning their royal uniforms. Stepping outside the academy, Loneal and Alec savor their time together, free from the concerns of others. Alec surprises Loneal with a thoughtful gift—a necklace—and hints at potentially calling off his engagement with Lily. The carriage ride back is uncomfortable, and when Loneal tries to express gratitude for the gift, Alec cooly responds, saying, "Why don't we pick up where we left off yesterday?"

Titles.eng: No Matter What Secrets You May Hold…

Summaries.eng: Venturing into the forest in search of antidote ingredients, Loneal falls prey to an attack by a mysterious hooded man. Fortunately, Alec comes to his rescue just in the nick of time. However, unsettling words from the mysterious assailant suggest that, in his previous life, Loneal might have been considered an enemy of the prince. Disturbed by this revelation, Loneal realizes he has lost the necklace gifted by Alec and, amidst the pouring rain, returns to the forest alone. Loneal is discovered by the concerned Alec. In a comforting gesture, Alec tenderly embraces Loneal, bringing warmth to his chilled heart and body.

Loneal, overwhelmed by guilt for changing the course of the original story, devises a plan to set things right. His idea  involves bringing Alec and Lily closer by inviting them to a picnic in the rose garden. However, as he witnesses them together, a pang of anguish grips his heart. Alec, who has long seen through Loneal's strategy, calmly inquires about the plan. Faced with the prince's cool and composed voice, Loneal realizes he can't keep anything from the dashing Alec.

Titles.eng: I Want to Love You, From Morning Till Night, Forever

Summaries.eng: Loneal is caught off guard when a sudden uniform inspection is sprung on him by the disciplinary committee. Panicking at the idea of his necklace from Alec being confiscated, Loneal is in a frenzy. However, an unfamiliar junior named Zeno steps in to help! Loneal quickly connects with the friendly and sociable Zeno but Alec, unusually moody, is displeased. With a brief greeting, Alec takes Loneal's hand and leads him into an empty classroom. Why would the prince react in such a stern way?

Titles.eng: Thank You for Teaching Me to Love

Summaries.eng: On the quest for magical potion ingredients, Loneal and Alec venture into the forest to gather medicinal herbs. However, their expedition takes a dark turn as they delve deeper into the wilderness! Lost in the forest at night, the two now face the challenge of struggling for survival. Despite Loneal feeling disheartened, Alec's comforting words provide a source of positivity. In the secluded woods, the two discover solace in each other's company...

Titles.eng: From the Depths of Our Beings

Summaries.eng: Having barely fended off the magical beasts, Alec, who protected Loneal, ends up poisoned. Feeling particularly powerless for lacking a sacred power like Lily's, Loneal falls into despair. In that moment, Alec's sincere and clear words echo in Loneal's mind. Fueled by a strong determination, a newfound power awakens within Loneal, and he does everything in his power to save the struggling prince!

After being tasked to concoct a magical potion, Loneal decides to enlist Alec's support. The potion progresses smoothly, however, an unexpected change occurs in Loneal's body! Alec's magical power flows into Loneal, as his body grows warm and a delightful feeling runs through him.  Finally, the secret of the love potion is revealed...
